# ŌLLIN OS

> ŌLLIN OS is sales intelligence software. It finds the accounts showing
> movement, verifies why they matter, and maps the people worth reaching.
> ŌLLIN OS finds it. ŌLLIN GO runs it. Nothing sends without your approval.

## What it does
- Finds account signals. Every signal shows its source.
- Checks every claim before it is used. "Unable to verify" is shown as-is, never guessed.
- Maps the whole account: the director, the manager, finance, talent. Every reporting line is labelled verified or inferred, so a deal is never single-threaded.
- Prepares the evidence, the reason to act, and a ready draft. Your team reviews it, adjusts it, and sends it.

## Three things it will never do
- Never invents: verifiable sources only. No made-up companies, people or facts.
- Never softens: a claim that fails a check is dropped, not hedged.
- Never sends on its own: ŌLLIN OS prepares. Your team reviews and decides.

## Who it is for
Sales teams that want fewer wasted swings: a real reason to reach out, and the right people to reach.
